name: Weave
summary: Phone, texting, payments and reviews unified for the front desk, tuned to dental, optometry and small healthcare practices. Get the all-in number in writing.
best_for: dental, optometry and small healthcare practices that want phone, texting, payments and reviews unified for the front desk
skip_if: you're outside healthcare/practice verticals, or you're a single small office where a simple VoIP line and a separate review tool cost far less
honest_knock: Two honest cautions. The $199 starting price is a floor, not the bill: add-ons, setup and per-location fees land on top, and the full tier ladder is only shown in a demo, so get everything in writing. And it's deeply tuned for healthcare and appointment-based practices; a general small business will find much of the workflow assumes a front desk and a patient schedule.

pricing.notes: Weave sells a per-location monthly subscription and its pricing page (weavehq.com/pricing, read 5 September 2026) now states plans start from $199 per location a month, though the exact tier ladder is still only shown after a demo. Practice owners commonly report all-in costs of roughly $400 to $700 a location once phones, payments and add-ons are bundled, plus a one-time setup fee of about $750. Quote-driven above the floor.

cost_traps.label: Key features are paid add-ons
cost_traps.evidence: Practice owners commonly report all-in costs of roughly $400 to $700 a location once phones, payments and add-ons are bundled, plus a one-time setup fee of about $750.

compare_with.name: Podium or a standalone VoIP plus review tool
compare_with.why: Podium is a close communications peer; a DIY stack is cheaper but less integrated — weigh the all-in quoted cost
